final_native_trusted_probes.invocation: AGENTS.md permits probe-by-probe validation. Original ordered scripts, original per-probe touch mode, isolated APPDATA/LOCALAPPDATA and eight-minute timeout; native Windows Start-Process supervision observes HasExited/ExitCode. Original failure/resource guards retained. The unchanged combat-tutorial probe uses the official --fixed-fps 60 clock: its 20-frame hold at time_scale 6 represents two simulated seconds against the unchanged 1.75-second charge threshold. No gameplay/probe code or assertion is changed.
final_native_trusted_probes.scope: All 82 ordered local probe obligations have complete passing source-bound executions, with zero exits and original failure guards clear. Initial case-filter correction matches the original case-sensitive guard. Uncapped tutorial assertion failure remains FAILED; unchanged tutorial passes with official --fixed-fps 60. Subsequent native Opera exit -1 remains FAILED. A uniquely named SHA-256-identical official copy passes Opera through balance, then Windows startup access violation remains FAILED. The final six unchanged menu/art probes already passed both original Bash attempts and full source CI; their actual successful blocks supply the final obligations. Composite success evidence is explicitly probe-by-probe, not a claimed green uninterrupted local run. All original static/art/audio/import/inventory stages pass. Windows native process/crash limitations remain open; full source CI is green.
